title: Sears Radio Theater
paragraphs: Weeknight anthology with a different genre identity each weekday.

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Fletcher Markle (director, producer, and performer), Elliott Lewis (producer, director, and performer), Marvin Miller (performer), Shepard Menken (performer and writer), Vic Perrin (performer), Andy Griffith (host and performer), and Cecily Tyson (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].
The stories often return to western drama, comedy, mystery drama, love and relationship drama, and adventure drama.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Late-1970s network radio drama revival, Five-night rotating genre format, and Move to Mutual Radio Theater.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], and [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]].
